srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — checked line by line against the file and every difference is by construction. (1) PARAMETERIZATION: every prop carries a demo default (title = "Personas", items = DEMO_ITEMS, defaultSelectedId, loading = false) so the record renders in a preview that mounts it with no props. (2) VENDORING: the file does `const { selected, select } = usePageSelection(...)`, importing `./useSelection` — a relative specifier a record may not carry — so the record inlines the same controlled/uncontrolled logic. (3) The record has an extra `loading` skeleton branch the file does NOT have, so it is the RICHER copy there and refreshing would DELETE a state variant. No stale content: the render is otherwise identical. Distinguished from its twin `tablepage`, which looked the same by score but did carry two real drifts (padding, and the shared ELLIPSIS refactor) and was partially merged. Hand-reviewed for `record-src-reconcile`.
